evidence.r1: Light and dark: glass is restricted to navigation, dates and ticket choices; schedule and editorial content use solid sheets.
evidence.r2: Light and dark ticket views: the menu replaces Tickets and selected rows use flat fills rather than another glass layer.
evidence.r3: Light and dark: only navigation, date selection and tickets form glass groups.
evidence.r4: Light and dark: navigation, dates and the ticket menu share one frosted material appearance.
evidence.r5: Light and dark: the controls show frosting rather than a separate clear-glass treatment over the snowy still.
evidence.r6: Light and dark resting views: Tickets is the sole saturated filled control and carries its red on the background.
evidence.r7: Light and dark: navigation and date surfaces visibly inherit different colours from the buildings and road signs behind them.
evidence.r8: Light and dark: navigation and dates use capsules while the ticket menu uses fixed rounded corners.
evidence.r9: Light and dark: the inset Thu 18 capsule follows the date-bar ends, and ticket selection follows the menu inset.
evidence.r10: Light and dark: Tickets and the selected ticket row have capsule outlines.
evidence.r11: Light and dark: navigation, date filters and ticket action are separated into three functional groups.
evidence.r12: Light and dark ticket menus: the close icon shares the same glass background as the ticket-choice text buttons.
evidence.r13: Light and dark: glass encloses each complete navigation, date or menu group rather than their individual labels.
evidence.r14: Light and dark: each bar is internally continuous and the three groups have deliberate separation.
evidence.r15: Light and dark scrolled tiles: one soft top-edge fade removes schedule and strand content beneath the floating bars.
evidence.r16: Light and dark scrolled tiles: the photographic band keeps a varied backdrop behind the floating bars.
evidence.r17: Light and dark resting views: the festival title and opening details are placed far below the navigation.
evidence.r18: Dark: black unselected date labels and ticket-menu text sit on middle-grey material with marginal small-text contrast.
evidence.r19: Reduced light: navigation remains readable, but increased contrast and reduced motion are not captured.
evidence.r20: Light and dark: the opening-film still fills the first screen behind the floating navigation.
evidence.r21: Light and dark: hero copy clears the bars and the scrolled sheet uses a soft top extension instead of a hard cutoff beneath them.
evidence.r22: Light and dark scrolled tiles: a persistent photographic backing band is placed beneath the bars above the scrolling sheet.
evidence.r23: Light and dark ticket endpoints do not reveal materialisation, morphing or pointer press feedback.
evidence.r24: Light and dark: bar labels are neutral black or white, including white text on the primary red ticket action.
evidence.r25: Light and dark: navigation and date labels use neutral ink rather than the red and blue sign colours behind them.
